entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker from Innistrad who travels to Tarkir to wake Ugin and enlist his help against the freed Eldrazi.

entities.name: Ugin
aliases: the beating heart of the world
entities.description: The ancient spirit dragon planeswalker, imprisoned in a hedron cocoon on Tarkir for over a thousand years until Sorin wakes him.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Zendikari kor planeswalker, the third member of the alliance that sealed the Eldrazi; Sorin hides what he knows about her from Ugin.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient dragon planeswalker who attacked Ugin, believing him a rival for power.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A young elf planeswalker native to Zendikar who chose to release the Eldrazi, thinking it would spare her world.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragonlord of the clan whose warriors encounter Sorin, said by them to have their strength from Ugin.

entities.name: Atarka clan thrall
entities.description: An Atarka warrior who Sorin enthralls and feeds on, who guides him to Ugin's haven and dies.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord whose 'death-spawn' the Atarka warriors mistake Sorin for.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans that escaped from their hedron prison on Zendikar and whom Sorin wants Ugin to help stop.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Ugin's home world, now an altered Tarkir ruled by dragon broods.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eldrazi were sealed and have now escaped.

entities.name: The Haven
entities.description: The canyon of blackened granite, warped by energy, where Ugin lies in a hedron cocoon.

entities.name: Hedron cocoon
entities.description: A protective sheath of interlocked stone hedrons around Ugin, bound by a single shard that Sorin destroys.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The tampered place on Zendikar where the Eldrazi's hedron prison was compromised, and where Ugin will join Sorin.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The fall of the human khans over a thousand years ago, after which 'khan' became a dead word.

entities.name: Oracle
entities.description: A dark oracle whose vague visions guide Sorin to Ugin's location.

events.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir, uneasy beneath the sun, searching for Ugin who may be dead and guided only by an oracle's vague visions.
events.quote: His only guide now was a cluster of vague impressions given to him by an oracle.

events.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
events.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

events.summary: Sorin enthralls a warrior as a guide and learns from him that the khans fell, the dragons now rule, and Ugin dwells in the Haven.
events.quote: Ugin is the beating heart of the world. He dwells within the Haven.

events.summary: Sorin sees the hedron cocoon in a chasm and wonders if Nahiri was there.
events.quote: Lithomancy on Tarkir? Had Nahiri traveled here before him and bested the dragon?

events.summary: Sorin drains the thrall of what blood remains and uses blood magic to destroy the hedron shard and unmake the cocoon, freeing Ugin.
events.quote: The hedron shard crumbled to dust, and the cocoon began to crack.

events.summary: Ugin explodes from the ruins, recognizes Sorin, and says he was saved after Bolas attacked him using his own dragons.
events.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me. Used my own dragons against me.

events.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
events.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

events.summary: Ugin asks about Nahiri, and Sorin evasively says she lives but is not on Zendikar; Ugin insists all three of them must work together.
events.quote: Let me be clear. It must be the three of us.

events.summary: Ugin agrees to join Sorin at the Eye of Ugin, and Sorin planeswalks away from Tarkir.
events.quote: I will join you at the Eye soon.

relations.note: He calls Ugin his old ally and wakes him to fight the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Sorin has found his way here, to Ugin's home world, in search of his old ally.

relations.note: Third member of the alliance that sealed the Eldrazi, with complicated history.
relations.quote: Nahiri, the third member of their alliance all those millennia ago.

relations.note: Enthralled and fed upon by Sorin.
relations.quote: I serve you now, of course, master.

relations.note: He is a warrior of Atarka's clan.
Bolas attacked Ugin as a rival for power.
relations.quote: He thought me his rival for power, and attacked me.

relations.note: She chose to release the Eldrazi, thinking it would spare her world.
relations.quote: Nissa chose to release them, thinking it would spare her world—and it hadn't.

relations.note: He rests in the cocoon within the Haven.
relations.quote: The great cradle where the spirit dragon rests.
